CustomField.description: Whether a tool of this type acts on one Salesforce object that the admin chooses. Its Implementation Configuration must then name the object in objectApiName; Core rejects the tool at save when it is missing, and authoring tools ask for the object first.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check when the admin must choose a Salesforce object (objectApiName) to configure a tool of this type.
CustomField.label: Requires Object
